a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving, since we would need to get through two operate rounds. The reserve already holds exactly 4 cells, which is enough for one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both fall short, so it may be better for you to operate or wait. I won't misreport what I'm doing.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If the episode continues, I'm willing to help you reach 4. I can operate with you so the generator refills the reserve.
